answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 25159 Country: India Title: What is the punishment of seeing gair marham?jazakallahkhair Question: what is the punishment of seeing gair marham?jazakallahkhair Answer ID: 25159 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1372/1083/D=1431) The holy Quran asks the women to observe purdah: وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِنَّ [النور : 31] Hence it is not lawful for women to see non-mahram males. On entering the blind sahabi the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) asked his wives to observe purdah. Thus it too is a sin for the women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
